lines.text: Twenty-one points. Four algorithms. Every one of them disagrees.
Add your own point, and watch the answer change.
Then open any of forty-two concepts — a lab, not a diagram.
Step k-means, or run it to convergence.
Every formula shows your numbers substituted in.
Change k, and the whole page recomputes.
Train a real network, and watch the four equations of backpropagation fill in with your gradients.
Machine learning you can poke. Learn visually dot fun.
